prompt:
Create one finished STATIC wide 16:9 anime illustration, a starting frame for a subtle relaxing drinking loop in a cyberpunk tavern. Use both attached images precisely:
Image 1 is the EDIT TARGET and the setting/composition reference: the existing underground tavern. Preserve its original wide camera view, perspective, left-side long bar with warm hanging lamps and magenta upholstered high bar stools, bottles behind the counter, center aisle and pink window, right staircase, and right foreground dining table. Keep the dark plum, magenta and warm amber palette, angular ink linework, hard-edged cel-shading and hand-painted texture. Do not redesign the environment, change the camera angle or turn it into photorealism.
Image 2 is the CHARACTER IDENTITY AND COSTUME reference: Noren. Transfer this exact character into Image 1, REPOSED into a convincing seated pose. Preserve her long near-black hair, purple-magenta eyes, angular dark hood, magenta trim, circular cybernetic ear accessory with cream rectangular hanging tags, asymmetrical worn dark cloak with magenta lining, belts, devices, opaque dark legwear and angular strapped boots. Preserve her face and the artist's original stylized proportions. Remove the white reference background completely.

Main requirement: Noren is ALREADY SITTING on one of the existing high stools at the LEFT BAR COUNTER, roughly centered at the left third of the picture, not at the right-side dining table and not floating in front of the room. Her hips genuinely rest on the upholstered seat with coherent contact and perspective. Show her whole seated figure, including both boots, inside the frame with comfortable margins. She is angled toward the bar, with her torso/head gently turned into a three-quarter view so the viewer can still see her face and recognizable ear accessory. Shoulders relaxed, calm slightly softened expression, quietly unwinding after work. One forearm comfortably rests along the counter, the corresponding hand naturally and clearly grips a simple low cylindrical glass containing amber liquor, held just above counter height after a sip. The glass is visible and separate from her face; clear rim, sensible grip, correct fingers. The other hand rests naturally on her lap. Her knees bend in a comfortable seated posture; her booted feet are visibly above the floor, one slightly ahead of the other, in a natural starting pose for gentle foot swinging. Legs remain covered in her original costume; no seductive framing. Cloak drapes naturally behind and beside the stool, keeping the knees and boots legible. Preserve stool/counter structural integrity and foreground/background occlusion.

Make her lighting truly belong in the tavern: warm overhead bar light on cheek, hand and glass, restrained magenta reflected light on cloak and boots, contact shadows on seat. Match her outline/shading to the original tavern rather than appearing pasted-on. Keep most of the room's original composition readable, center and right comparatively calm. This is a still image only, crisp and production-ready, with no motion blur, no UI, no added title, subtitles, watermark, new signage, other people, split panels, extra arms or hands. High visual fidelity to the supplied originals is more important than inventive decoration.
